subject: Re: CloudTrail-style audit bundle request — admin activity logs & delivery
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@healthspan.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: compliance@healthspan.com
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: CloudTrail-style audit bundle request — HealthSpan SIG review

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team ran through the SIG and have a specific ask around admin activity evidence for our SOC 2 / vendor-approval checklist: they want a CloudTrail-style bundle that includes all admin/console events (grants/revokes, role creation, API key ops), operator session starts/stops, deployment/rollout events, and the operator-initiated config changes. Key asks:

- List of event types and schema (timestamp, actor id, actor role, source ip, affected resource, before/after snapshot)
- Retention snapshots (we need a 90-day hot export + 12-month archived bundle)
- Delivery formats (NDJSON preferred; Parquet acceptable) and compression expectations
- Integrity proofing: checksums, signed manifests, and chain-of-custody notes
- Delivery options: S3 presigned PUT, encrypted FTP, or secure Transfer Appliance (we may request an on-prem handoff)
- Estimated time to produce a full 12-month export and per-quarter deltas

I've attached our SIG snapshot requirement template. Can you confirm what Redwood can deliver and any constraints we should be aware of (sampling, PII redaction, or retention limitations)?

Appreciate a bulleted response we can share with our auditors.

Cheers,
Emily Park\Security & Compliance Manager\HealthSpan Medical

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@healthspan.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, compliance@healthspan.com
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudTrail-style audit bundle request — HealthSpan SIG review

Emily —

Thanks for the clear ask and the template (attached). Below is what Redwood can provide today and recommended best practices to meet your SIG/SOC 2 needs. High level first, then delivery details.

Summary (TL;DR):
- We log admin activity comprehensively: console actions, API key lifecycle events, role/permission changes, config deployments, user/session start+end, and operator-initiated job runs.
- Default retention in Hosted is 90 days for high-fidelity event stores; we can produce 12-month export bundles on request (note: creating full historical bundles beyond 90 days requires coordination and may incur an extraction fee for large volumes).
- Delivery formats supported: NDJSON (line-delimited JSON), gzip-compressed Parquet, and CSV slices for sampling. All files can be signed (SHA256) and we produce a signed manifest (PKCS7) with checksums.
- Transfer methods: S3 presigned PUT (recommended), S3 presigned GET (if we push to your bucket), secure SFTP (customer-managed), and for large physical handoffs we support Transfer Appliance workflows (on-prem ingestion team coordinates).

What we include in each event (schema highlights):
- event_time (ISO8601), event_id (UUID), actor_id (internal user id), actor_email (if available), actor_role, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, before_snapshot (optional, for config edits), after_snapshot (optional), source_ip, user_agent, request_payload_ref, response_status, request_id, kv_cache_tag (if relevant), and region.

Retention & snapshots:
- Hot store: 90 days (immediate access, low-latency query)
- Archive: We can produce 12-month bundles as NDJSON/Parquet. For customers that need continuous 12+ month retention we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where retention policies are configurable.
- For your request (90d hot + 12m archived bundle): we can provide a full 12m bundle within 5 business days for up to 2TB of compressed logs; larger sizes will need a scoped extraction (we'll surface estimated run-time and cost).

Integrity and chain-of-custody:
- Each export contains a manifest.json.gz with per-file SHA256 checksums and a PKCS7-signed manifest (we sign with our platform key). We also include extraction logs with timestamps and operator IDs (who initiated the export).
- For additional assurance we can provide notarized checksums via an agreed third-party timestamping service; this is an add-on.

PII/redaction:
- We do not perform automatic PII redaction on admin activity exports by default; we include sensitive fields as-is in the export and advise customers to apply redaction in their processing pipelines. We can support a limited set of server-side redaction transforms on a per-request basis (signed data-processing agreement required).

Delivery options & recommendations:
- Presigned PUT to your S3 (our recommended fast, secure option)
- If you prefer us to push: presigned GET URLs or AWS cross-account copy (requires IAM config)
- SFTP endpoint (enterprise customers only)
- Physical Transfer Appliance (for >50TB exports)

Next steps / actions needed from HealthSpan:
1) Confirm preferred delivery method and destination (S3 bucket ARN + required bucket policy or SFTP endpoint).
2) Confirm whether you require server-side redaction or third-party notarization.
3) Approve cost/turnaround for a 12-month dump if >2TB and confirm timeline expectations.

I've attached our admin activity schema PDF and copied Vivek (ops) and Soojin (security) to validate the extraction playbook.

—
Priya Natarajan\Senior Security & Solutions\Redwood Inference\priya.natarajan@redwood.ai\+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: CloudTrail-style audit bundle request — HealthSpan SIG review

Priya / Soojin — quick ops notes from my side:

- Confirming we can generate NDJSON and Parquet exports with per-file gz compression.
- For historical extraction we run a staged job: index -> assemble -> compress -> sign -> push. Indexed jobs for 12 months at ~3TB compressed typically complete in 2–4 business days; edge cases at high cardinality may go longer.
- We require a signed export request (to log operator consent) and an S3 bucket policy when pushing to customer buckets.
- Cost: there's a one-time extraction handling fee for >2TB (est. $1,200 for 2–5TB) — we will produce a scoped quote once HealthSpan confirms size estimate.

I'll coordinate a dry-run for a 30-day delta export to validate the pipeline if HealthSpan wants to test before the full 12-month deliverable.

Vivek\Lead Infra Engineer\Redwood Inference

Emily —

Thanks — quick summary & ask for sign-off so your auditors have a single doc to reference:

Deliverables we will provide:
- 90-day hot access (platform console + API)
- 12-month archived bundle in NDJSON (gzip) and Parquet (optional)
- Signed manifest with SHA256 checksums + extraction operator audit log
- Signed export request (we will log operator who initiated the export)

Customer actions required:
- Provide target S3 bucket ARN and bucket policy OR provide SFTP endpoint details.
- Confirm whether you want server-side redaction (list fields) or acceptance of raw exports.
- Confirm acceptance of the extraction fee for >2TB if applicable.

If this matches your needs I will: (a) create a scoped export request, (b) schedule a 30-day delta dry-run, and (c) provide an estimated cost/timeline for the full 12-month bundle.

If you want notarized manifests or physical handoff we will scope those separately.

Please reply with: preferred delivery method + redaction preference + rough data size estimate (we can help estimate if you only have workload descriptors).

Regards,
Priya

Attachments: HealthSpan_SIG_Snapshot_Req.xlsx (provided by HealthSpan), redwood_admin_activity_schema.pdf (platform schema)
